answer: Post a standing sybil bounty: anyone who proves two accounts share one operator, for example via a reused signing key or the same planted canary phrase in both outputs, claims all unvested rewards of both. A fake ring is a walnut that looks solid until one crack shows, and every rival or hired node runner is paid to find it. As payout nears the horizon, the attacker must hide each link perfectly or lose the whole farm, so every jetty of fakes is a liability.
